changes.content: egress-gateway — managed egress gateway fronting the private application network. Default-deny outbound. Not a deployable the product team releases; a platform component the platform team owns.

One allowlist entry at Cycle 1: the competent authority's FBO register, consumed by identity-service via INT-4.7. Every allowlist entry carries a destination, a named owner and a stated reason — PLT-C5 checks all three.

Timeout posture is PENDING (PLT-PEND-04): the gateway fronts a call whose latency budget is itself PENDING (INT-PEND-04), and setting one now would make the gateway's timeout the de facto budget by accident — established by an infrastructure default rather than by a decision. Ships with the platform default, recorded as a default rather than a decision.

Emits per-destination metrics and denied-attempt logs to the observability platform (PLT-12). A denied attempt is a signal, not a silent drop — an unlisted destination someone is trying to reach is exactly what PLT-C5 exists to surface.

The gateway authorises the DESTINATION and holds no caller credentials. Caller authentication is the vault's, read at runtime by wi-identity. TLS is not terminated here — no inspection, no re-encryption.
